item.name: Get Dashboard
item.description: All admin endpoints require ADMIN role. Non-admin requests receive 403.

request.description:
Returns all data needed to render the admin dashboard in a single request. All 20 database queries run in parallel.

Role: ADMIN only.

Sections returned:
- stats: platform-wide counts (users, landlords, properties, feedback, engagement)
- recentRegistrations: last 5 sign-ups (excludes admins)
- latestProperties: last 5 property listings created
- topProperties: top 5 published properties by view count
- recentFeedback: last 5 feedback submissions

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of all properties across all landlords with optional filters. Used for the admin property management page.

Role: ADMIN only.

Query parameters:
- isPublished (boolean) — filter by published status
- isFeatured (boolean) — filter by featured status
- isAvailable (boolean) — filter by availability
- search (string) — case-insensitive title search
- landlordId (UUID) — filter to a specific landlord's properties
- propertyId (UUID) — filter to a specific property by ID
- page (int, default 1) — page number
- limit (int, default 20, max 100) — items per page

Response includes favouriteCount and reportCount per property.

Returns full property details with all related data: landlord info (with account status), images, amenities, house rules, parkings, daily view history, user reports, and favourite count. Admin can view any property regardless of published status.

Role: ADMIN only.
